name: digital-marketing-postiz
start: if ! docker info >/dev/null 2>&1; then sudo dockerd --storage-driver=vfs >/tmp/dockerd.log 2>&1 & sleep 5; fi; if [ -f postiz/docker-compose.yml ]; then cd postiz && sudo docker compose up -d; fi

terminals.name: postiz
terminals.command: cd postiz && sudo docker compose logs -f postiz
